role: Design and Engineering, Built with the Community
dek: A tracker for Nioh 3, built alongside the game's community to fill a gap: the wikis fell short and strategy guides are no longer printed, so players had nowhere reliable to track their progress.
short: A progress tracker for Nioh 3, built with the game's community where the wikis fell short and printed strategy guides no longer exist.

highlights.title: Built with its users
highlights.text: Shaped alongside the players who use it, where the wikis failed and printed strategy guides stopped.

images.alt: Nioh 3 Tracker: the Clans page, with rank pickers, blessings and base-to-max values per clan
